meta.note: Reference scheme from seed #e8735a (coral). At runtime every color role is regenerated from the wallpaper; these values are what Reef shows with no wallpaper or in Static mode.

color.note: M3 color roles. Tinted = TonalSpot surfaces. Neutral = Neutral-variant surfaces with the same accents (the Apple-like setting). Island tokens are fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent. Active toggles, the selected workspace, focus rings, the Pearl's glow.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Filled expressive buttons in the control center, the active cay segment, progress tracks' fill.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.usage: Secondary accents: slider thumbs, chips that are on but not the main action.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface

tokens.name: inverse-primary

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: The Island and the Pearl, in every theme: pure black, so it reads as a cut-out in the display rather than a panel. Never tinted, never translucent.

tokens.name: on-island
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on the Island.

tokens.name: on-island-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the Island (artist, timer label). 8.9:1 on island.

tokens.name: island-container
tokens.usage: Containers inside the expanded Island: tab content wells, clipboard rows, Coral's chat bubbles. Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: island-container-high
tokens.usage: Raised or selected containers inside the Island: the active tab chip, hovered rows, the reply field. Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: island-accent
tokens.usage: Live accent inside the Island (waveform, progress, Coral's pulse). Dark-theme primary tone, so it stays bright on black in light mode too. Media can override it with the album art's color.

tokens.name: on-island-accent
tokens.usage: Icons on island-accent buttons (the Island's play button). Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: island-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress tracks inside the Island. Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the desktop behind the power menu and edit mode.

tokens.name: screen-corner
tokens.usage: The concave corner pieces that round the screen (SURFACES.md → Global rules). Fixed in every theme.

spacing.note: 4px grid. The global Spacing scale in Settings multiplies every step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a cay; between stacked toggle-tile rows.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-2-5

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a cay; gap between cards in a panel.

tokens.name: space-3-5

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5

tokens.name: space-6

motion.note: M3 Expressive springs (MOTION.md). damping is the M3 damping ratio (1 = no bounce, mass 1). duration and bezier are the fallback curve for places that can't run a spring. Everything is multiplied by the Animation speed setting.

spatial-fast.usage: Password shapes, toggle thumb, pressed squash, cay hover grow.

spatial-default.usage: Island expand/collapse, Tide panels, search from the Navigator cay.

spatial-slow.usage: Island to Pearl, lock entry, workspace overview zoom, bar to the left.

effects-fast.usage: Icon FILL, label weight on press, hover tint.

effects-default.usage: Panel content fades, toggle color changes.

effects-slow.usage: Wallpaper-scheme crossfade, scrim in and out.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay between list items.

tokens.name: stagger-max
tokens.usage: Items after this one share the last delay.

tokens.name: content-fade-delay
tokens.usage: New content fades in this long after the old starts fading out (Island mode change).

tokens.name: reduced-fade
tokens.usage: With Reduce motion, spatial motion becomes a crossfade of this length.

tokens.name: settle-epsilon
tokens.usage: A spring stops when position and velocity are both within this fraction of the move.

tokens.name: island-reveal-delay
tokens.usage: Pointer time at the top center before the hidden Island drops in (MOTION.md).

tokens.name: island-hide-delay
tokens.usage: Pointer time away before a revealed Island hides again.

tokens.name: osd-timeout
tokens.usage: The OSD stays this long after the last change.

tokens.name: toast-timeout
tokens.usage: A toast stays this long (longer with an action, see toast-action-timeout).

tokens.name: toast-action-timeout
tokens.usage: A toast with an action (Undo) stays this long.

tokens.name: wave-period
tokens.usage: Time for the wavy progress to travel one wavelength while playing.

opacity.note: M3 state layers and disabled content.

tokens.name: state-hover

tokens.name: disabled
